Package dev.px.core

Class CoreBuilder

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.CoreBuilder
public final class CoreBuilder extends Object
Builds the Core instance.

Only the Platform is required. Everything else has a working default, so a minimal bootstrap is three lines and a client only supplies what it actually wants to change.
